item.title: A new spot
item.dc:creator: Tim
item.description: I’ve blogged all over the place. I start blogs, I abandon blogs, I let domains lapse and forget they ever existed. Somewhere out there is a whole graveyard of “Hello World” posts.
item.content:encoded:
I’ve blogged all over the place. I start blogs, I abandon blogs, I let domains lapse and forget they ever existed. Somewhere out there is a whole graveyard of “Hello World” posts.

So I wanted a fresh start. Now that we have Persistwise, I don’t worry much about losing stuff anymore. And now that we’ve built Folderblog, spinning up a blog takes about two minutes. That’s how I ended up running three of them. It turns out that when blogs are easy to make, you make more blogs. Who knew.

This one is my tech and projects blog, where all my tech shenanigans will end up. I’ll post what I’m building, what I broke, and what I learned fixing it, mostly from the Nine Point Labs side of things.

If you build it, they will come. Or at least a few of you will, and that’s plenty. Pull up a chair and stick around.

Cheers!
